sources.title: Introducing GPT-5.3-Codex
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27, 2026. The February 5 announcement introduces this exact model and says it advances GPT-5.2-Codex coding and GPT-5.2 reasoning capabilities together. Its training/deployment section describes early versions debugging the training run, analyzing behavior and improving serving; it supplies no nominal total or active count and no named, sized base from which either can be inferred.

sources.title: GPT-5.3-Codex System Card
sources.evidence: Reopened the original 31-page February 5, 2026 PDF on October 27. Read the introduction and training/safeguard sections and searched its complete extracted text for parameter counts. Sections 4.1.2 and 5.2.1.3.1 describe reinforcement learning and safety training, not model size; no total or active parameter disclosure was found. The layered monitors are deployment safeguards, not a specification of the underlying network.

sources.title: GPT-5.3-Codex API model documentation
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27, 2026 through official documentation and the fresh exact-model Markdown. The record lists gpt-5.3-codex, deprecated status, 400,000 context, 272,000 maximum input, 128,000 maximum output, text/image input, text output, reasoning, Responses, functions and caching. No separate dated snapshot, total-parameter field or active-parameter field is supplied.

sources.title: OpenAI API changelog
sources.evidence: The February 24, 2026 entry explicitly records release of gpt-5.3-codex to the Responses API, later than its original Codex product launch.

sources.title: OpenAI API deprecations
sources.evidence: The October 1, 2026 notice lists gpt-5.3-codex with scheduled API shutdown April 1, 2027. Deprecated status does not mean it has already reached shutdown.

sources.title: Introducing GPT-5.4
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27, 2026. The March 5 GPT-5.4 announcement includes exact GPT-5.3-Codex comparison columns for coding, computer use and other evaluations. Those columns report benchmark performance, not total or active parameters. Incorporating earlier coding capabilities does not identify GPT-5.4 as an unchanged-structure GPT-5.3-Codex variant.

sources.title: GPT-5.4 Thinking System Card
sources.evidence: Reopened the later GPT-5.4 Thinking card on October 27 and searched the full extracted PDF. Tables 7-9 and cyber comparisons explicitly identify gpt-5.3-codex but report safety/performance results, not parameter counts. Neither a total nor a separately labeled active count for this exact model was found.

sources.title: Prompt Caching 201
sources.evidence: This archived OpenAI technical guide explicitly applies to models before GPT-5.6. Section 2.1 explains OpenAI prompt caching through Transformer attention key/value projections. Combined with the exact model caching feature, this supports only a broad Transformer-based inference, not complete block composition, dense/MoE topology or counts.

sources.title: File inputs
sources.evidence: Responses API PDF processing for vision-capable models extracts both text and page images. Together with the exact model documented image input and Responses support, this supports PDF as an API input format, not a separate native sensory modality.

sources.title: OpenAI Services Agreement
sources.evidence: Section 9.1 reserves OpenAI service IP and grants limited service use rather than ownership. Together with this model hosted distribution and official model inventory, this supports the descriptive proprietary classification, not an open-weight license.

sources.title: OpenAI model inventory
sources.evidence: The official inventory lists GPT-5.3-Codex among deprecated hosted models; its separate Open-weight models section lists gpt-oss-120b and gpt-oss-20b under Apache 2.0. No GPT-5.3-Codex downloadable weights are offered by the checked primary release and model pages.

sources.title: GPT-5.5 System Card
sources.evidence: Freshly opened the April 23, 2026 original card on October 27 and checked its complete extracted text. Tables 3-5 compare exact gpt-5.3-codex on destructive-action avoidance, reversion and confirmations; Table 17 reports cyber policy compliance. These later exact-model tables provide no nominal total or active parameter count. References to monitors or later-model training do not establish GPT-5.3-Codex size.

sources.title: Introducing GPT-5.3-Codex-Spark
sources.evidence: Freshly opened October 27. The February 12 announcement explicitly identifies Spark as a smaller version of GPT-5.3-Codex, with text-only input and a 128k context at launch. It supplies neither model a numerical total or active count. This structural size distinction rules out treating Spark specifications as unchanged-size lineage evidence for the full model.

sources.title: GLM-5: from Vibe Coding to Agentic Engineering
sources.publisher: GLM-5 Team, Zhipu AI and Tsinghua University
sources.evidence: Freshly opened the February 17 original model-team report after targeted later-comparison searches. Tables 10 and 11 explicitly separate total and activated parameters, but only for GLM/open-model rows; the paper has no GPT-5.3-Codex entry. Its GPT-5.2 performance comparisons and other models' activated counts cannot establish a count for this exact model.

name.note: Use the official hyphenated model name; this is not GPT-5.3-Codex-Spark.

developer.note: OpenAI publishes and develops the exact model.

family.note: Normalize to the GPT-5.3 generation named by the model identifier; Codex is the coding specialization. This does not assert shared weights with Instant or Spark.

release_date.note: Earliest public release was in Codex on February 5. Responses API availability followed February 24, 2026. The undated API identifier is not a dated immutable snapshot.

open_weights.note: Documented distribution is hosted Codex/API access. The checked official release, model page and separate open-weight inventory offer no downloadable weights for this exact model.

license.note: Descriptive classification of hosted OpenAI access with reserved service IP; no open-weight license is published for this model.

parameters_b.note: October 27 fresh re-audit: the original release/training discussion, exact API record, original card and later GPT-5.4/GPT-5.5 comparison tables supply no nominal total count or explicitly identified sized base. The named Spark relationship is structurally smaller, so its specifications cannot transfer. Bounded searches for later first-party disclosures and original model-team size tables found no supported count; retain null.

active_parameters_b.note: Rechecked active parameters separately on October 27. Original and later OpenAI exact-model tables provide no active-count column or numerical activation specification. Fresh searches for active/activated/total parameter tables found no supported exact-model count; the GLM-5 original report's explicit activated-parameter tables contain other models only. No dense total=active assumption or transfer from Spark/successors is justified.

architecture.note: Qualified inference: exact-model documentation enables prompt caching, and OpenAI pre-GPT-5.6 caching documentation describes Transformer attention KV state. This establishes a broad Transformer-based classification only. Exact-model training/interpretability searches and checked cards did not establish complete block composition, dense/MoE layout, layer counts or numerical model size.

context_window.note: Documented total context is 400,000 tokens. The same source separately states maximum input 272,000 and maximum output 128,000; retain the total rather than substituting either limit. Documentation does not prove endpoint operation.

modalities.note: Native documented inputs are text and image, with text output. PDF is retained as an API-supported format because this exact model supports vision and Responses; the file-input guide processes PDFs into extracted text and page images. No audio/video generation is claimed.

reasoning.note: Exact-model API documentation lists reasoning tokens and low, medium, high and xhigh reasoning efforts.

tool_call.note: Exact-model Responses documentation explicitly supports function calling, web search, hosted shell and skills.

description.value: OpenAI reasoning model optimized for agentic coding, with text and image input and tool calling.
description.note: Replace promotional or loosely scoped wording with supported purpose and interface capabilities.

patch.name: GPT-5.3-Codex
patch.description: OpenAI reasoning model optimized for agentic coding, with text and image input and tool calling.
patch.notes: Released in Codex on February 5, 2026; the Responses API launch followed February 24. The API identifier is undated, with no separate dated snapshot documented. The 400,000-token context has a 272,000-token maximum input and 128,000-token maximum output. PDF denotes API extraction into text and page images. Transformer is a qualified broad inference from prompt caching and OpenAI pre-GPT-5.6 KV-cache documentation. Detailed topology and total/active parameter counts remain undisclosed in the checked OpenAI sources; Spark is a distinct smaller model. Deprecated October 1, 2026, with API shutdown scheduled April 1, 2027; live endpoint operation was not tested.

summary: October 27 parameter re-audit: retain total and active parameters as null/undisclosed after reopening original OpenAI evidence, reading later GPT-5.4/GPT-5.5 exact-model comparisons, checking the explicit smaller Spark relationship and searching later first-party/model-team disclosures. GLM-5 activated-parameter tables do not identify this model. Explicitly patch both parameter values and parameters_source to null. Preserve the other twelve field assessments and their original corrections.
